endpoint.capability_description: Search indexed job listings across companies

cost.note: Not free: $1.6e-05–$0.04 per hit across 7 providers, 0% markup. A call also pays each provider tried before the hit that bills a miss (1 of 7 do), up to X-Treg-Route-Max-Cost (default $1); X-Treg-Route-Waterfall: 0 pays for one provider only

title.note: identity; job title words ('data engineer'); with name or domain, that role at that company

name.note: identity; the employer's whole name as the company writes it ('Ramp'): every job index asked for a name matches the whole name, so 'Ramp' never finds LiveRamp, and a company listed under two names answers for the one sent. For one company's own board, treg.companies.jobs takes the board itself: the whole board on Greenhouse, Ashby and Workable, up to `limit` (at most 100) on Lever and SmartRecruiters

country.note: filter; ISO alpha-2 country of the job ('US', 'GB')

location.note: filter; free-text place of the job, finer than country ('Texas', 'New York, NY', 'Berlin'), passed to providers that take one

remote.note: filter; true: remote jobs only. false or absent: no remote filter

posted_within_days.note: filter; posted (or first seen) in the last N days. Absent, TheirStack still asks for the last 30 days: it has no open/closed flag

limit.note: filter; default 10; rows to return — most providers bill per row; PredictLeads (by domain) bills one flat price for up to 500 rows. On treg.companies.jobs, a board named by ats: Greenhouse, Ashby and Workable answer the whole board whatever limit is, free; Lever and SmartRecruiters answer up to limit, at most 100

input.note: Send what you know; treg sends each provider only the fields it accepts ({domain, title} | {name, title} | {title} | {name} | {domain}). On a miss it tries the next provider, cheapest first. Options are X-Treg-Route-* headers, never body fields. The answer is {output, raw, _treg}; X-Treg-Served-By names the provider.

endpoint.name: companies.jobs.search — routed: best of 7 providers, own keys first
endpoint.summary: Search open job postings by title across companies, or at one company by name or domain — provider-native job rows in `jobs`
